newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ramos refuses to intervene in PAL pay dispute.
newsitem.headline: Ramos refuses to intervene in PAL pay dispute.

text.p: President Fidel Ramos on Wednesday rejected a plea by Philippine Airlines (PAL) workers for him to intervene in their long-running pay dispute with the national carrier, saying he was not a labour arbiter.
Ramos said during his weekly news conference that the Department of Labour and Employment (DOLE) was already in touch with both management and workers in an attempt to solve the dispute.

PAL unions on Tuesday urged Ramos to intervene to help avert a potentially embarrassing strike called to coincide with next month's Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit, which the Philippines is hosting.
"I passed (the union request) immediately to the DOLE because I should not be a labour arbiter," Ramos said.
Ramos welcomed PAL management's offer to sell shares to employees unhappy with a proposed new wage agreement, saying this was part of the solution DOLE was trying to get the two sides to accept.
